headline: Approved consent agenda of liquor licenses and permits for five businesses, including Yen Restaurant and Onion River Hotel.
summary: The consent agenda covered renewal and new license and permit requests for five businesses. A motion to approve the consent agenda as proposed carried 4-0. Truc Cao of Yen Restaurant gave a brief overview of the new restaurant.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda as proposed, covering five license and permit items, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Councilor Goodrich to approve the consent agenda as proposed, seconded by Councilor Turkos. Motion carried 4-0.

decision_titles: Consent agenda of liquor licenses and permits
